title: Mega Man Battle Network 6 · Cybeast Gregar
intro: Follow the story, strengthen your folder and find the health, memory and utility upgrades before the final battles.
libraryIntro: All five Cross classes, Beast Out, restored Boktai content and every HP/memory upgrade.
primer: Lan explores the real world; MegaMan explores the network. Examine electronic devices and jack in when the story or a side path requires it. If you are stuck, use the talk-to-partner button, read new mail, and speak to the named person again.

Battles happen in real time on a panel grid. The Custom Screen pauses the action while you choose chips. Select copies of the same chip or chips with the same letter code in one turn. Order matters: MegaMan uses them in the order selected.

Your Folder must contain 30 chips. Begin with one or two main codes, reliable attacks and a few defensive chips. A smaller set of compatible codes is often more useful than 30 unrelated powerful attacks. Empty a weak chip from the folder when you add its replacement.

There is no experience-level grind. HPMemory increases maximum health; equipment and your folder provide the other improvements. Save before bosses and before trading chips. Chip Traders consume the chips you put in, and later games save the transaction.

Crosses replace Souls. Earn five by taking the version’s Link Navi classes, then choose a Cross from the Custom Screen without sacrificing a chip. A Cross lasts until you change it or take its elemental weakness. A broken Cross cannot be used again that battle.

Gregar Beast Out lasts three turns and can combine with a Cross. Gregar favors aggressive rapid fire and has protection from flinching. Manage the Beast counter instead of forcing the uncontrollable Beast Over state.

BN6 still rewards a chip counter with Full Synchro. Cross/Beast states do not use the ordinary Full Synchro damage bonus, so sometimes staying in Normal is the better choice for a counter-based folder.

NaviCust now permits parts to extend outside the main grid, but breaking the placement rules can still introduce bugs. Follow the tutorial, keep a clean setup while learning and use the two Expansion Memories. Regular Memory improves REG; Tag Chips are a separate linked pair.

Legacy Collection restores Undernet 3, Graveyard 1, Immortal Area and the Boktai story/chips removed from the English GBA release. Follow this collection route rather than an old guide’s shortened area names.
features: Only the first Cross is required at its story checkpoint. Take the other four as they open; they provide flexible combat tools and more Link Navis for rescues.
The story, all ordinary HP/memory upgrades, the chip library and postgame bosses are separate goals. Normal story progress does not require 200 chips or every request.

warning.label: Before taking optional requests
warning.title: Keep Self Research until you have its chips.
warning.text: Self Research locks you into a request needing Anubis P and two PoisSeed P. Accepting it before the ordinary requests and Graveyard progress can block the remaining request rewards. Finish the original request list and obtain the chips first. This affects optional completion, not the story.

routeIntro: These chapters follow the story’s fixed order. Optional Navi rematches and collection goals come afterward; they are not a selectable boss chain.
route: Play the chapters below in order. Buy early HPMemory before spending your spare zenny on random chips.
Visit side devices as each area opens. The grouped inventory below lists every ordinary permanent HP and memory upgrade.
Before the final sequence, save, refill health and choose a folder that can damage the final boss. Reload the clear-marked save for postgame.

stages.name: New school incident
stages.tip: Finish the robot-dog tutorial. In class, use the CopyBot, get water from the punished student outside class, then get TeachrID from the downed teacher. Enter the security system and rescue its burning programs. When trapped, speak to Mick three times and inspect the teachers’ orange monitor. Return to rescue the remaining programs and reach BlastMan.

items.name: Central Area 3 key
items.text: After BlastMan, read Mick’s note and inspect the shadow beneath the Central 2 ledge for KeyData. Open the Central 3 gate.
items.when: During the chapter, or return if missed

stages.name: Aquarium emergency
stages.tip: Ask a teacher about penguin food, speak to the class 6-2 child and the bus-stop elder. Read Seaside 1’s BBS; if water blocks access, clear the virus in Lan’s toilet for ToolPrgm and give it to Central 3’s repairman. At the aquarium, inspect the exhibits, attend the show and follow the escape. Use the CopyBot to fetch the seal’s ball from the pool, then enter the system.
notes: Program identities in Aquarium 1: cow-eater = piranha, short tail = sunfish, warm water = tropical fish. Area 2: proud = king crab, ancient = nautilus, steady = turtle. Area 3: whale = dolphin, nose = seal, flight = penguin, lizard = alligator. Scout the shark routes before escorting each program.

items.name: NaviCustomizer
items.text: Read the aquarium-day mail and close the menu to start the tutorial. RUN after every edit.
items.when: During the chapter, or return if missed

items.name: Virus Battler Card
items.text: After the aquarium, buy BtlrCard from the HeelNavi in the class 1-2 blackboard for 2000z. It unlocks the optional virus-versus-virus minigames.
items.when: Return when the requirement is met

stages.name: First Cross class
stages.tip: Use Fire chips and HeatMan’s charge to delete four Kettle encounters: Central 1 café, Central 2 main path, two in Central 3 near the statue and Sky ramps. Return to Match for the exam.

items.name: HeatMan Cross
items.text: Pass this class and its final Navi battle. Use the earned Cross directly from the Custom Screen; no chip sacrifice is required.
items.extra: Fire attacks and a strong fire charge.
items.when: During the chapter, or return if missed

items.name: Tag Chip system
items.text: After DiveMan, read the aquarium director’s mail. Set a compatible pair in Folder Edit within the shown combined-MB limit. Drawing one also draws the other; they do not become REG chips.
items.when: During the chapter, or return if missed

stages.name: Cybeast awakening
stages.tip: Respond to the Expo promotion, then clear the evil spirits using the given Soul weapons. Red spirits fall easily; approach the stronger spirits from behind rather than taking their counterattack. Follow the story to absorb Gregar and complete the Beast Out tutorial before CircusMan.
notes: Beast Out lasts three Custom turns. You can combine it with a Cross. When the counter is empty, use normal combat; forcing Beast Over makes MegaMan attack without your control and leaves him very tired. It is not needed to win.

stages.name: Green Town investigation
stages.tip: For courtroom access, join Lawyers in the Making at Green Town HP for 1000z and hear the law before opening Green 2’s café gate. After Dad’s arrest, examine the classroom camera, free the robot from the closet and inspect the school security control. Return with the evidence. Enter the courthouse’s left-side outside path and basement; learn Law 153 from the lawyer Navis for the lock.
notes: JudgeTree paths can use each tile only once. Survey the whole puzzle before walking, then plan a route through every switch and the exit. You can return for side data after the story puzzle is cleared.

items.name: Expansion Memory 1
items.text: Open the blue data in JudgeTree Comp 3.
items.when: During the chapter, or return if missed

items.name: SlashMan Cross
items.text: Take the Green Town class after the first trial, before or after the later crisis. Start from the book computer. Slice the vegetables by following the displayed button sequence. Clear cabbage, carrot and radish targets across the three areas; later inputs add the action and shoulder buttons. Return to Pat for the exam.
items.extra: Charge sword chips for an extended sword attack.
items.when: Return when the requirement is met

stages.name: Expo preliminaries
stages.tip: Enter Sky Town through the antenna. Defeat the two judge Navis in Sky 1 and the two in Sky 2, then report to the central Navi. After the Undernet scene, use a Link Navi and retrace the route from Central 3 to rescue MegaMan. Link Navis cannot use your NaviCust or collect MegaMan’s HPMemory.

stages.name: Weather crisis
stages.tip: Fix the elevator computer, then jack into the three outdoor devices to shut them down. Inspect the lockers for the real administrator. Use the CopyBot and the upper outside ledge to cross the broken route. In Mr.Weather Comp, ride clouds to gather rainbow data, then draw a closed loop around each typhoon.

items.name: Pink rotation
items.text: Collect Mr.Weather Comp 3’s blue data. Rotate matching NaviCust programs with the shoulder buttons.
items.when: During the chapter, or return if missed

items.name: ElecMan Cross
items.text: After the weather crisis, take the helipad class. Meet Ann Zap at the helipad computer. Find two batteries in Sky 1 and five in Sky 2. Emergency-light panels are safe from the roaming enemies. Avoid their fixed routes, then return for the exam.
items.when: Return when the requirement is met

stages.name: MoonStone contest
stages.tip: Inspect the locked Undernet door, question the Green Town punishment-room man, then speak to the girl outside Seaside’s toy shop three times. Return with the password. In Undernet 2, walk in the direction the two staring HeelNavis face to reveal the invisible MoonStone passage. Return to Central square and speak to everyone.

items.name: EraseMan Cross
items.text: Complete the second school-lab class before the next rescue. Hunt the marked gang Navis in Undernet 1 and 2. Approach outside their sight and press the action button; hold it to stay invisible while stationary. Being spotted starts a battle rather than ending the test. Return to Dark Scyth for the exam.
items.extra: Cursor chips and a finishing attack against low-HP enemies.
items.when: Return when the requirement is met

items.name: ChargeMan Cross
items.text: Complete the aquarium vending-machine class. Meet Al Ferry and enter the vending-machine computer. Board the train in Undernet 2 near the left ramp; collect passengers and charge through rocks. Follow the train signs to each later test. Return for the exam.
items.extra: Charge Fire chips for stronger attacks.
items.when: Return when the requirement is met

stages.name: ACDC reunion and rescue
stages.tip: Speak to everyone in ACDC, enter through the squirrel statue, then retrieve the gate key from Dex’s shogi piece. Help the program and report to Roll for AreaPass. Follow the kidnapping to Undernet 2’s skull/BBS platform. Save and heal for consecutive fights. After MegaMan is captured, visit Mr. Mach on Sky Town’s upper ledge, ask the Underground guard for access, then investigate the school principal.
notes: Use your most comfortable Link Navi to clear Underground 1–2’s spirits and fight MegaMan’s Beast form. MegaMan then returns for Colonel. Go back with MegaMan for the health data the Link Navi could not collect.

items.name: Expansion Memory 2
items.text: Open Lab Comp 2’s blue data, reached from the Undernet 1 connection. It completes the 5×5 grid.
items.when: Return when the requirement is met

items.name: White rotation
items.text: Buy RushFood from Sky Town’s shower-computer Navi and use the ACDC bone tile to reach the blue data.
items.when: Return when the requirement is met

stages.name: Expo and final Cybeast
stages.tip: Follow the Undernet BBS lead to Sky Town, then invite all named friends for the Expo. Finish useful returns before sleeping. At the gala, visit the first three pavilions for stamps. During the attack, inspect the principal’s bookshelves for the secret path. Clear Aquarium, JudgeTree, Weather and spirit puzzles in sequence; their control panels open the next room. Save before the final door.
notes: Against Gregar, aim at the head after it lands or while it commits to a major attack. It cannot be interrupted. Avoid the flashing panels before its 2×3 slam; recovery and a barrier give room to learn the short attack openings.

returnIntro: Open one destination to see all of its HP, Regular Memory and Sub Memory upgrades together. BMD means blue Mystery Data; PMD means purple data and needs an Unlocker. FMD is fixed data in BN1. A merchant’s listed prices are separate stock purchases, not a repeatable reward.
completionText: All 45 ordinary HPMemory items bring base maximum health to 1000. Sub Memory raises Sub Chip carrying capacity; Regular UP raises the MB limit for the guaranteed opening chip. NaviCust HP programs add temporary equipped health above the base.

sections.title: Build a useful folder
sections.html:
Start with attacks you can line up reliably: Cannons for the row ahead, Vulcan for a lined-up target, and swords for enemies close to your front panel. Keep recovery and Invis alongside them while learning movement. Replace these attacks as stronger same-code options arrive.

ToolHow to use it
Compatible codesThe * code works with any letter. Use * support chips to keep turns flowing.
AreaGrabMoves your front line forward and brings swords into reach. Do not stand on the front column without a reason.
Invis / GuardProtects a vulnerable approach. Invis does not protect from every attack; piercing attacks can still hit.
Program AdvanceSelect Sword → WideSwrd → LongSwrd with the same letter code, in that order, for LifeSwrd. The combo replaces those chips for the turn.
Regular ChipSet a useful chip as REG in Folder Edit. It is guaranteed in the opening selection if its MB fits your Regular Memory.
ElementsFire → Wood → Elec → Aqua → Fire. A weakness doubles damage. Fire also burns grass panels, and electricity is dangerous on ice.

Chips spent during a battle return afterward. They are not consumed from your pack, except for explicit trades and a few story systems that say they consume them. Download Chips and Buster MAX are optional collection aids; build the ordinary folder first if you want to learn the original combat.

The matching chapter above explains each test. Return to the operator after completing the task and win the Navi exam. You can later rematch Link Navis through their operators.

sections.title: Optional · skull doors and utility parts
paragraphs: From the Green 2 giant tree, inspect its back to enter the hidden Undernet Zero path. Follow it to Bass; victory awards BatKey. Buy WWWID from the Undernet Zero HeelNavi for 3000z to open the skull doors.

Blue rotation is in Sky 1’s purple data behind a cloud. Use a suitable Link Navi to remove the obstacle, then collect the data with an Unlocker. Red / Green / Yellow rotation lotto numbers are 77837421 / 09256524 / 41976910 at AsterLand. These are built-in lottery inputs, not cheats or modified saves.

sections.title: Optional · Django and the Count
paragraphs: From chapter 7 onward, use BatKey at Underground 2’s northeast purple door to reach Immortal Area. Walk to the large platform at the far northeast for the Count encounter. Survive until the event ends: he cannot be damaged yet. Django then gives you SunKey. Enter Undernet Zero from Undernet 2 (door code 012), open Otenko’s prison and speak to him. Return to the Count’s platform in Immortal Area; this time your attacks work.
GunDelSol works better with sunlight: jack in from an outdoor device when building a sun-based folder. The collection’s crossover points and Boktai trader are separate from ordinary HPMemory.

The Virus Battler chain gives useful exclusive rewards, including Django3 D from the fifth machine. The old English-language reward bug was fixed in July 2023; current collection builds do not require switching the text to Japanese. If using an old offline build, update it before completing the chain.

sections.title: Optional · Graveyard and completion
paragraphs: After the clear mark and 100 Standard chips, open the Graveyard route from Undernet 3. Complete the Mega library to pass into Graveyard 2. This includes the restored Count and Django entries. Complete ordinary requests before the extra-card requests so ProtoMan’s higher rematches remain available.
Reach Bass in Graveyard 2 for the SP fight. After victory, return to Underground 2’s deepest arena for the stronger Beast encounter followed by Bass BX. Prepare the folder and save beforehand.

All completion marks cover story clear, the 200 Standard chips, Mega library, Giga library, every Program Advance and Bass. Opposite-version entries require trading or compared-library chip ordering. Disable Buster MAX for new SP deletion-time records.

Extra request Patch Cards are available in the collection’s Patch Cards menu. Read the request conditions before adding them. If Self Research was accepted too soon, trading/library access or the legitimate Chaud item card can supply the missing ProtoMan entries; this is an ordinary collection feature.

sections.title: Useful tips
paragraphs: Set * support chips beside one main code so AreaGrab, Invis and recovery do not block an attacking turn. Try Tag Chips with a compatible attack pair rather than two unrelated high-MB chips.
Save before boss pairs and before taking an unfamiliar optional request. Travel health stays depleted after ordinary battles; carry FullEnrg or recovery chips for long routes.
Use the relevant Link Navi to remove flames, trees, clouds and water obstacles, but return as MegaMan for HPMemory. NaviCust-equipped health and base HPMemory are different systems.
